title: Clamp a blank with an eccentric cam
context: Machine loading needs a blank to stay registered after the robot lets go. This task combines registration with a passive cam clamp rather than stopping at placement.
scoring: Score zero if the blank falls more than 4 mm below the tabletop. Registered placement earns 0.25 when the blank centre is within 3 mm on each axis of x 280 mm and y 77 mm and z 788 mm with tilt and yaw below 5 degrees. Loading must be observed with the cam below 5 degrees. After loading cam travel of 45 degrees or more earns 0.5 while the blank stays registered. Closing past 92 degrees earns 0.75 only when the compliant stop is deflected by at least 0.1 mm and the signed cam to blank gap is between negative 2 mm and positive 1 mm. Blank speed must be below 8 mm per second and rotation below 0.1 radians per second. The gap is measured from the cam circle to the blank clamping body in its current XY frame. The cam radius is 28 mm and eccentricity is 8 mm. Both grippers open beyond 35 mm raises this to 1.0 only when no robot body is in contact with the blank or cam or compliant stop. Contact separation of 1 mm or less counts as contact. Full success must hold for 2 seconds. All other outcomes score the highest satisfied stage.
fidelity: Rigid PA12 polymer props. The cam has a passive revolute joint and a physical end stop. The backstop spring stiffness is 1500 N per metre. Deflection provides a preload check. An XY circle to box gap approximates cam contact under the 5 degree tilt limit. A PhysX view checks robot contact each physics step with a 1 mm threshold. No deformation or fracture or calibrated holding load rating is claimed.
instruction: Place the orange blank flat against both grey fixture stops. Hold it there while turning the blue cam lever to its closed stop past centre. Release both grippers. Leave the blank clamped after release. The fixture is bolted down and unpowered.
setup: Use the official bimanual YAM station. The tabletop is at z 747.5 mm. x points forward. y points left. z points up. All props are rigid PA12 polymer prototypes. All joint positions start at zero. The cam fixture has an initial outer envelope of 210 by 300 by 38 mm. Its authored root is at x 280 mm and y -35 mm and z 747.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The blank has an initial outer envelope of 60 by 154 by 65 mm. Its authored root is at x 160 mm and y 140 mm and z 769.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its mass is 0.155 kg. Its root is free to move. The starting pad has an initial outer envelope of 80 by 80 by 8 mm. Its authored root is at x 160 mm and y 140 mm and z 751.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The inventory lists each collider and body mass and joint anchor and travel limit. Local solid positions are measured from the named body root. Outer envelope sizes describe the reset pose.
run_limit: 2400 control steps at 20 Hz. This is 120 seconds of control time.
reset_notes: Restore every object to the starting pose in scene_inventory.json and every joint to zero. Nothing is consumed. Use one epoch with seed 0 and object_jitter=0.
